text.p: These are the leading stories in the Lebanese press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- U.S. under pressure to lift travel ban on Lebanon.
- U.N. peacekeepers to stay in southern Lebanon for another six months.
- New Lebanese brokerage rules aim to encourage mutual funds.
- Albright facing pressure to lift travel ban.
- Albright is leaning towards replacing the travel ban on Lebanon with a strong warning.
- President rejects taxes before a halt to overspending.
- Parliament speaker Nabih Berri to visit Tehran in September to meet Iran's new president, Mohammad Khatami.
